{{Quote|Sir, enemy fleet's coming out of hyperspace!|The naval officer, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="bfr">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>}}
A '''clone navigation officer''' served aboard the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==Biography==
While [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were discussing a rescue plan for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been captured by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]] and taken to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], the [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone navigation officer]] reported to them that [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces were [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|approaching]] from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. This naval officer and many clone troopers were all killed by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
